changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO tpr_buy_out_surplus_transaction ( id, transaction_code, account_id, target_period_id, charge_type, invoiced_buy_out_fee, invoiced_payment_deadline, file_document_uuid, performance_data_resource_type, creation_date ) SELECT bk.id, bk.transaction_code, pd.account_id, tp.id AS target_period_id, bk.data ->> 'chargeType' AS chargeType, (bk.data ->> 'invoicedBuyOutFee')::numeric AS invoicedBuyOutFee, (bk.data ->> 'invoicedPaymentDeadline')::timestamp AS invoicedPaymentDeadline, bk.file_document_uuid, 'ACCOUNT' AS performance_data_resource_type, bk.creation_date FROM tpr_buy_out_surplus_transaction_bak bk JOIN tpr_performance_data pd ON pd.id = bk.performance_data_id JOIN tpr_target_period tp ON tp.id = pd.target_period_id WHERE tp.business_id = 'TP6';

changeSet.author: P70383
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO tpr_buy_out_surplus_transaction_detail ( id, buy_out_surplus_transaction_id, performance_data_id, buy_out_fee, payment_status, data, payment_date ) SELECT nextval('tpr_buy_out_surplus_transaction_detail_seq'), t.id, bk.performance_data_id, bk.buy_out_fee, bk.payment_status, bk.data - 'invoicedPaymentDeadline' - 'chargeType', bk.payment_date FROM tpr_buy_out_surplus_transaction_bak bk JOIN tpr_buy_out_surplus_transaction t ON t.transaction_code = bk.transaction_code;

changeSet.author: P70383
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO tpr_buy_out_surplus_transaction_detail_history ( id, buy_out_surplus_transaction_detail_id, payload, submitter_id, submitter, submission_date ) SELECT bk.id, td.id, bk.payload, bk.submitter_id, bk.submitter, bk.submission_date FROM tpr_buy_out_surplus_transaction_history_bak bk JOIN tpr_buy_out_surplus_transaction_detail td ON td.buy_out_surplus_transaction_id = bk.buy_out_surplus_transaction_id;
